resources.string: While parked, confirm the target screen and calibrate its visible map area. Choose independent map or main-screen mirroring, then reconnect CarPlay. This does not change the OEM cluster mode.
Selected screen is unavailable or its identity changed. Select it again; no other screen will be used.
No accessible secondary screen. Enable the original instrument projection mode, then reopen this page.
Did the test image appear on the intended instrument projection area? Confirm to save this screen and enable the map at the next connection.
This screen cannot show a Presentation. The selection was not saved.

Independent map uses the phone cluster channel. Mirror follows the main CarPlay picture and app changes without requesting a second phone display. Local framing can show the full picture or a crop. Save, then reconnect CarPlay.
A 1920×720 screen defaults to the right 720×720 window. Start with Right square, then adjust the four edges to the visible map area while parked. Save, then reconnect CarPlay.
These controls crop the video locally on the cluster. They do not move the phone car marker. Center and zoom apply only in Crop picture mode. Save, then reconnect CarPlay.
